An Embedded PC is a specialized computer system integrated as an essential part of a larger machine or industrial system. Unlike standard consumer PCs, Embedded Box PCs are designed for maximum reliability, maintenance-free operation, and long service life. They perform dedicated tasks such as data acquisition, machine control, or machine vision directly at the point of use. Why Choose an Embedded Box PC from IPC2U? Fanless Design: No moving parts mean reduced wear and protection against dust intake. Extended Temperature Range: Many of our systems operate reliably from -40°C to +70°C. Industrial Interfaces: Direct integration via COM (RS232/422/485), dual Gigabit LAN, GPIO, and modern interfaces such as USB 3.2. Compact Design: Ideal for DIN-rail mounting or wall mounting in confined control cabinets. Applications: Where Are Embedded Computers Used?
